name: Enthralled
source:
ENTHRALLED is a hypnotic game about getting seduced and mind-controlled by a demanding vampire queen, played by the Secret Subject! The full game lasts for 45-60 minutes, while the free demo lasts for 15-20 minutes.

It uses real hypnosis and toys heavily with D/s dynamics, fractionation, obedience, getting turned into a vampire's mindless thrall, being told to resist trance (and failing), and being made to wear a collar.

[From [url=https://nyxgaming.itch.io/enthralled]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《ENTHRALLED》是一款催眠游戏，讲述的是被一位要求严格的吸血鬼女王引诱并进行精神控制的故事，由秘密主题扮演！完整游戏时长为45-60分钟，免费试玩版时长为15-20分钟。

它使用真正的催眠和大量玩弄D/s动力、分裂、服从，变成吸血鬼的无意识奴隶，被告知要抵制催眠（和失败），并被要求戴上项圈。

[来自[url=https://nyxgaming.itch.io/enthralled]Itch.io[/url]]
